description: This file defines the Step3 controller class for the OpenCart installation process, handling the display and processing of database configuration during setup.

classes.name: Step3
classes.description: Controller class for the third step of the OpenCart installation process, managing database setup and configuration file creation.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the installation step 3 page with database configuration options.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes submitted database configuration data, attempts database connection, writes configuration files, and redirects to the next installation step.
